Q9033.reason: VCLT Article 31 requires good-faith interpretation by ordinary meaning in context and in light of object and purpose; D’s “only” drops the rest of that rule.

Q9036.reason: A keloid is an overgrown firm mass of scar tissue beyond the wound; a fine hairline scar is a normal minimal scar.

Q9037.reason: Tracheostomy is commonly used to help wean patients from prolonged ventilation; it does not repair paralyzed vocal cords.
